Only a one-step scalar cancellation. The preconditioner precedes momentum; time-varying scalar weights change the accumulated direction. The claimed training-trajectory equivalence is false in general.
findings.evidence: Source order: right precondition gradient, then momentum/NS; native mathematical audit.

findings.assessment: rho=(trace K-sum retained eigenvalues)/(n-r) is undefined at full rank. Use an explicit exact-inverse branch. For r<n the inverse formula is valid for its eigen-plus-isotropic surrogate.
findings.evidence: Proposal specialized_operation and reviewer algebra claim.

findings.claim: Low-rank inverse necessarily saves optimizer memory and refresh work.
findings.assessment: It still retains full K and pays for its construction/EWMA. Full eigh stays cubic; iterative extraction on dense K costs roughly q*n*n*r. Count those costs and compare polynomial inverse plus larger refresh intervals.
findings.evidence: Newton-Muon Appendix A/B and proposal refresh description.
